description: Complete rewrite of XAUUSD ProTrader EA from 4000+ line over-engineered version to lean 484-line procedural EA that will actually take trades. Uses EMA 21/50 on H1 for trend, M5 price vs EMA21 for entry, RSI 14 confirmation. Zero includes, raw OrderSend with filling mode fallback, simple trailing stop.
steps: Rewrite XAUUSD_ProTrader_EA.mq5 completely - remove all SMC, news filter, dashboard, class-based architecture
Implement simple EMA 21/50 H1 trend + M5 EMA21 pullback + RSI 14 signal generation
Implement raw OrderSend with FOK/IOC/RETURN filling mode fallback
Implement automatic lot sizing based on risk percentage
Implement simple trailing stop that activates after X points profit
Add Print() debug statements for Experts tab visibility
Update README.md to reflect v2.0 simplified approach
Verify braces balanced, no includes, under 500 lines
acceptance_criteria: Uses raw MQL5 OrderSend() with MqlTradeRequest/MqlTradeResult
Signal fires on every new M5 bar where EMA trend is clear and RSI confirms
No news filter by default (InpNewsFilter = false)
No session filter by default (InpSessionFilter = false)
Simple risk management: 1% risk, max 2 positions
Trailing stop: 200 points activation, 150 points distance
Filling mode fallback: FOK -> IOC -> RETURN
New bar detection using iTime comparison
Print statements for all key events (signal, order, trailing)
findings: Complete rewrite from 4094 lines to 484 lines. Removed: SMC analysis, complex signal scoring, news filter engine, multiple trailing modes, dashboard/HUD, class hierarchy, session filters. Kept: EMA trend detection (simplified to 21/50 from 50/200), RSI confirmation (simplified to zone check), automatic lot sizing, trailing stop (simplified to single mode), position counting. The key change is that signals now fire whenever EMA alignment + RSI zone match on any new M5 bar, instead of requiring impossible confluence of SMC + news + session + minimum strength score.
